scope: Exactly two production files and one existing test file in the separate mutation-guard worktree. Frozen SID sources and shared repository were read only.

confirmed_defect.condition: Task XML A is exported and retained; another writer replaces/removes the task before the forward Delete. Old production performs no observation between durable retention and name-based deletion.
confirmed_defect.consequence: Old production can delete or replace the now-observable external B, or act on an absent/unknown task. The durable A snapshot alone does not authorize that current mutation.

implemented_boundary: After the existing durable prior snapshot, one current ExportXML must return no error, nonempty bytes, and exact equality with the cloned prior bytes before forward Delete.
A read error, including nonempty matching bytes plus an error, takes priority and is retained with %w. An empty success, disappearance, or different XML refuses deletion.

Required replacement failure calls the existing failAfterRollback. The current task has not reached Delete/Create or new compensation construction. Previously acknowledged tasks still compensate in reverse order.
Optional prune emits the existing skip-style warning, including retained snapshot path and read cause, then continues without adding a current-task compensation.
No interfaces, dependency, global test hook, native mutation primitive, retry loop, recovery owner, or snapshot-retention policy were added or changed.

test_review.matrix: Both forward deletion sites; same XML, changed XML, missing, empty, read error, and matching XML with error. Assertions cover exact state, zero forbidden mutation counts, durable snapshot content/hash and diagnostic path.
test_review.earlier_rollback: An earlier acknowledged fresh creation is removed after current refusal. Injected earlier-delete failure retains only that earlier task in InstallSchedulerRollbackIncompleteError, with both original causes. Current B remains untouched and excluded from recovery ownership.
test_review.prune_compensation_oracle: A forced later install error after each prune case proves that a refused prune did not arm compensation; matching prune restores its retained original bytes.
test_review.adaptation: Only two export fault selectors changed: rollback failures begin when the existing intermediate callback starts rollback; post-Create capture errors are selected by createCount > 0. Their original cases and assertions remain unchanged, preserving semantics under the extra forward read.
test_review.negative_control: The same candidate test file against old production distinguishes 12 denied subcases; two new roots also fail, for 14 FAIL terminal test events, while two matching subcases pass. These are expected events, not execution results.

call_graph_admission.new_root_entry: executeInstallTo -> executeInstallToWithSymlinkConsents -> memory rollbackFixtureScheduler / durable own-root snapshot operations; prune adds installedServerNameSet under the test MCPHUB_MANIFEST_DIR_OVERRIDE.
call_graph_admission.scheduler_factory: installRecoveryPlan replaces schedulerFactoryFn with the supplied memory fake and restores it through t.Cleanup.
call_graph_admission.state_root: installRecoveryPlan registers SetDaemonStateRootForTest(root) cleanup; roots are created with hardenedTempDir(t).
call_graph_admission.owned_windows_permissions: hardenedTempDir creates a new private directory under t.TempDir and applies the existing protected access list to that new directory only. Snapshot files are written and read back through the existing owner-only state functions.
call_graph_admission.cleanup: t.TempDir owns temporary fixture files; t.Cleanup restores state-root and factory globals; t.Setenv restores the new prune catalog override. No selected root uses t.Parallel.
call_graph_admission.not_reached: startTasks=false, no client updates, only memory Scheduler methods, no native Scheduler backend, subprocess, network listener, installed Hub/Product, credentials change or system policy change.
call_graph_admission.package_startup: Parent must retain separately qualified API TestMain admission fixtures and the exact offline D environment; this source-only review does not execute or independently qualify the whole package startup.

limitations: Read-to-Delete race remains. This change is an observational precondition, not atomic generation safety.
An external replacement with identical XML cannot be distinguished; XML equality is not process, security-descriptor, credential or generation authority.
Native Run, RunOwned, Stop, Delete, process-tree cancellation/lifetime, cross-domain SID resolution and external native concurrency are not qualified by these memory tests.
No Go/gofmt/build/vet/test or native action was executed. Formatting, compilation, runtime event counts and full suites remain unverified.
Prior BackendRunHold and prune qualification are not claimed as repeated. A new composed input requires parent-selected affected checks; the patch itself leaves the hold file unchanged.

own_review.requirements: No blocking findings in the reviewed source scope. Both sites deny observed drift and preserve prior recovery material.
own_review.correctness: Error-before-bytes, absence refusal, no current compensation, earlier rollback and its incomplete error owner are directly asserted.
own_review.security: On changed or unreadable current state, name-based forward mutation is refused. No stronger generation claim is made.
own_review.compatibility: Existing optional-prune warning versus required-replacement error semantics retained; two existing fixture phase selectors adapted without assertion removal.
own_review.complexity: One shared private observation helper, two direct call sites, existing exportHook and snapshot fixtures; no second recovery framework.

composition.rule: Apply the two pre-delete hunks to the SID-compatible install.go; do not replace that file with this worktree whole-file candidate. Other two changed files have no SID overlap.
composition.combined_identity_method: In-memory exact replacement of the single frozen SID hunk in the pre-delete candidate; equality of that replacement against the frozen SID source from the same base was asserted. No combined file or worktree was written.
composition.backend_run_hold: This patch does not touch install_parsed_manifest.go. Preserve the existing master75/660 composition and its BackendRunHold behavior; do not replace it from the older #660 tree.
